title: The 4 Best Blackout Curtains Under $60
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for blackout curtains under $60, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at blackout curtains under $60 using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: Lush Decor Insulated Grommet Blackout Curtain Panel Pair
products.blurb: Key specs: 52 x 84 inch pair, 2 panels, typically $30 to $35, Microfiber fabric with built-in insulation, no separate liner needed, 1.65 inch metal grommets.
strengths: Full pair with built-in insulation at roughly half the price of many premium pairs
52 by 84 inch size fits most standard bedroom windows without hemming
Metal grommets feel more substantial than plastic ones on cheaper pairs
limitations: Lighter colorways block noticeably less light than the darker options
Some buyers report a factory odor on first unboxing that airs out after washing
features: 52 x 84 inch pair, 2 panels, typically $30 to $35
Microfiber fabric with built-in insulation, no separate liner needed
Blocks approximately 95% to 99% of light depending on color

products.name: Exclusive Home Curtains Gates Sateen Blackout Curtain Panel Pair
products.blurb: Key specs: 52 x 63 inch pair, 2 panels, typically $25 to $35, Sateen twill weave with Light Block and Thermax lining, 8 matte silver grommets per panel.
strengths: Sateen finish looks noticeably more polished than a matte utilitarian panel at this price
Thermax lining adds real thermal insulation, not just a marketing claim
8 grommets per panel glide smoothly and evenly on the rod
limitations: 63-inch length is short for taller windows or higher ceilings
Fewer total ratings than the Eclipse or Sun Zero product lines
features: 52 x 63 inch pair, 2 panels, typically $25 to $35
Sateen twill weave with Light Block and Thermax lining
Blocks light and blocks harmful UV rays

products.name: Lush Decor Sheer Grommet Curtain with Insulated Blackout Lining
products.blurb: Key specs: 38 x 84 inch pair, typically under $30, Sheer face fabric with insulated blackout lining sewn in, Grommet top.
strengths: Sewn-in lining means no separate liner purchase, unusual at this price for a sheer-style panel
Softer daytime appearance than a solid matte blackout panel
limitations: Blocks somewhat less light than a solid laminated panel at the same price
Narrower 38-inch width needs more panels for a wide window
features: Sheer face fabric with insulated blackout lining sewn in
Softer daytime look while still blocking light at night
